note: Sound effects made with ACE-Step (Nadav, 2026-11-18: 'make the sounds with ACE-Step for everything: choosing, the screens'). Stingers, not loops: each is generated at 10 s and the game keeps only its first 0.3-2 s (cut-sfx.py). Same key (F minor / Ab major) and the same 90s G-funk / Rhodes world as the music, so they sit with it.

choose.label: בחירת תשובה בדו-שיח
choose.prompt: a single short warm Fender Rhodes chord stab in F minor played by a session player, dry, quickly fading, no drums, intimate room, analog tape warmth

button.label: כפתור START / CONTINUE
button.prompt: one crisp funky muted electric guitar chord stab with a tight rimshot, very short and dry, late 1990s West Coast funk session, analog warmth

vs.label: כרטיס ה-VS של הבוס
vs.prompt: dramatic fighting game versus stinger, one huge brass and orchestra hit with a deep timpani boom and a gong swell, cinematic tension, tongue-in-cheek swagger

levelup.label: LEVEL UP
levelup.prompt: triumphant short level up fanfare, bright brass section and a sparkling synth arpeggio rising to a big major chord, celebratory, live horn players, 90s game swagger

smash.label: הדמות שוברת את המונטאז'
smash.prompt: a dramatic reveal hit: a deep cinematic boom with a bright reverse cymbal riser into a big Rhodes and brass chord, punchy, exciting

item.label: ITEM ACQUIRED
item.prompt: short happy item acquired jingle, sparkling Fender Rhodes and glockenspiel arpeggio rising and landing on a bright chord, playful wink, warm analog production

ministart.label: התחלת מיני-גיים
ministart.prompt: short punchy arcade start jingle, a funky live drum fill into one tight horn stab, energetic, laid-back swing, analog tape warmth

miniwin.label: סיום מיני-גיים
miniwin.prompt: short cheeky victory jingle, slap bass and a horn section riff ending on a bright stab, mischievous grin, live players, late 90s funk

unlock.label: סיסמה נכונה
unlock.prompt: a satisfying unlock success chime, a lush Fender Rhodes ninth chord with shimmering bells and a soft swell, dreamy relief

wasted.label: WASTED / כישלון
wasted.prompt: comedic sad fail sting, a muted trombone sliding down wah-wah over a low bass note, deadpan, dry, short
